title: A table document, as the engine answers it (Table)

name.description: a field's name, or an entry's id

title.description: an entry's title; null for a field and for an entry with none

value.description: a field's value as written; null for an entry

source.description: where in the original it was read, as written; null when it says none

lines.description: an entry's own lines; none for a field

Table.Line.description: One line of a table as a reader sees it.

lines.description: its lines, in order: the fields, then the entries

description: What a table document is to a reader: its lines as a reader sees them — each field's name and value as written, each entry's id and title with its own lines —, which is what a shelf of the library lists and an inspector shows. A program reads the sheet they make from the document's tree (sheetOf).
